name: Sudoku100 API
description:
Free Sudoku puzzle generation API — no registration, no API key required.

Generate Sudoku puzzles as images (PNG / WebP / SVG / JPG) in six difficulty
levels, or fetch a specific puzzle by ID. Every puzzle is generated in real
time with a guaranteed unique solution.

- 6 difficulty levels: beginner, easy, medium, hard, expert, extreme
- 4 image formats: PNG, WebP, SVG, JPG
- Custom image width: 100–1000 px
- Deterministic puzzles by ID: 1–10000
- Multi-language documentation (41 languages)
